page.layout: One scanned image of a book cover (vellum or limp binding) seen from the front; no printed text block. Spine label at the left edge carries handwritten or printed lettering partly visible ("Hom" and a fragment below it), which is part of the binding, not a text block.
page.notes: Blank cover: no printed page. Spine label fragments visible at the left edge, only partly legible ("...Hom II", "...mus"); not transcribed as page text because they are on the binding and cannot be read reliably. Stains, worm-like marks and the dark scan border are not printed text.
